# WalnutAI

> An AI ecosystem for software delivery from intent to production.

WalnutAI is a SaaS platform that intelligently orchestrates the entire software delivery lifecycle — transforming requirements into development, driving comprehensive testing, and proactively identifying gaps for continuous improvement.

## Core Capabilities

- **AI-Orchestrated SDLC**: Assign tasks to AI bots that generate requirements, code, and tests end-to-end with no human-in-the-loop.
- **Continuous Gap Analysis**: Instant insights on missing test coverage and requirement gaps.
- **AI-Generated Test Cases**: Comprehensive test case generation from user stories in seconds.
- **From Documents to Structured Requirements**: Automated validation ensures no requirement goes uncaptured.
- **AI-Powered IDE Development**: Integrated development environment with AI assistance.
- **Test Execution & Management**: End-to-end traceability ensures every requirement is verified.
- **Unified Analytics & Insights**: Real-time dashboards track pipeline health and deployment metrics.

## Key Metrics

- 1 prompt from idea to production
- 5 min for first gap analysis
- 15+ hours saved per sprint
- 96% average requirement coverage
- 80% reduction in release risk

## Use Cases

- Fresh Application Development
- Modernization & Tech Upgrades
- Requirements Engineering
- Quality Assurance & Testing
- CI/CD & DevOps Integration

## Pricing

- **Starter**: Free — for individuals and small experiments
- **Pro**: $49/month — for growing teams shipping regularly
- **Enterprise**: Custom pricing — for organizations with advanced needs
